ai.title: WebVue AI
ai.description: Ask about your tasks and projects, and request what you want prepared. WebVue AI prepares, you approve.

thread.empty: Start with a question like: "Which of my tasks are overdue?"

confirm.title: Needs your confirmation
confirm.executing: It was started by an earlier request. Refresh the page shortly to see the result.

draft.title: I prepared a draft
draft.hint: Review it on its real page and submit it yourself. Nothing is sent before that.

limits.monthly: Your company reached its WebVue AI message limit for this month.
limits.run: This request stopped because it exceeded the allowed number of steps.
limits.timeout: The request took longer than allowed.

errors.unavailable: WebVue AI is unavailable right now. Try again later.
errors.provider: Could not reach the AI model. Try again later.
errors.decide: Could not save your decision. Try again.
errors.auditFailed: The action was done but logging it failed.
errors.resumeFailed: The action was done but the assistant could not finish its reply.
